name: DES J0007-4434 (Hubble)
blurb: DES J0007-4434, a strong gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: desj00074434-hubble
story: The gravity of a foreground galaxy bends and stretches the light of a more distant galaxy behind it, a natural lens first spotted in Dark Energy Survey images.

claims.text: DESJ0007-4434 was graded definitely a lens
DESJ0007-4434 was found as a strong lensing candidate in Dark Energy Survey images
AGEL000729-443446A at the same position has a measured background source redshift and Hubble imaging from program 16773
